annotations.title: Update a copied email-reading rule to its author's latest version

description: Brings a hack the person copied from the community up to the latest version its author shared (list_tracks or check_tracks says when there is one). A copy nobody changed takes a minor or patch version by itself, so this is for a major version (it reads different emails, or changes fields: test_hack it on read_inbox's messages first) or a copy the person changed: the author's template and senders replace the copy's. Refused if the new version would no longer fill the columns its sheets need.
name: update_hack_from_community
title: Update a copied email-reading rule to its author's latest version
